title: Good practices for Bayesian Optimization of high dimensional structured spaces
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了高维结构化空间中贝叶斯优化的实践，其方法可迁移到植入物设计中的代理模型优化，但未涉及生物力学或FEA。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no uncertainty quantification beyond standard BO.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维结构化数据优化中，如何设计搜索空间以提升贝叶斯优化效果？
summary_zh.method: 系统分析潜在空间维度、采集函数和边界定义对优化性能的影响。
summary_zh.result: 提供了潜在空间维度选择、采集函数和边界自动定义的实践建议。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实数据集上通过数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To provide practical guidelines for Bayesian Optimization in high-dimensional structured spaces by studying the impact of search space design choices.
summary_en.method: Systematically analyzes the effects of latent space dimensionality, acquisition function, and automatic bound definition on optimization performance.
summary_en.result: Offers recommendations for practitioners on latent space dimension, acquisition function selection, and bound setting.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical experiments on synthetic and real datasets.

title: Data-Informed Decomposition for Localized Uncertainty Quantification of Dynamical Systems
first_author_affiliation: Probabilistic Design and Optimization Group, GE Research, 1 Research Circle, Niskayuna, NY 12309, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Waad Subber
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Probabilistic Design and Optimization Group, GE Research, 1 Research Circle, Niskayuna, NY 12309, USA

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于贝叶斯推断的区域分解方法，用于局部不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型中的多尺度问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on localized UQ for dynamical systems with a Bayesian decomposition approach.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低多尺度动力学系统高分辨率数值模拟的计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 利用贝叶斯推断识别局部感兴趣区域，并仅在该区域进行高分辨率不确定性传播。
summary_zh.result: 在三维弹性动力学问题上验证了方法的有效性，减少了整体计算量。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验在三维弹性动力学算例中验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce computational cost of high-resolution numerical simulations for multi-scale dynamical systems by focusing on localized regions of interest.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian framework identifies the localized region of interest from measurements, then propagates uncertainty only in that region with fine discretization.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments on a 3D elastodynamic problem demonstrate reduced computational cost while maintaining accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validation via numerical simulation of a 3D elastodynamic problem.

title: Clustered active-subspace based local Gaussian Process emulator for high-dimensional and complex computer models
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过聚类主动子空间降维构建局部高斯过程代理模型，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的高维仿真加速。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design, lacks constraint handling, and does not include uncertainty quantification beyond emulator error.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维复杂计算机模型仿真昂贵，现有代理模型难以处理全局低维结构。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于梯度信息的聚类主动子空间方法，识别局部低维结构并构建局部GP代理。
summary_zh.result: 数值算例表明该方法能有效处理具有复杂低维结构的模型。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值基准测试验证聚类和局部GP的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: High-dimensional and complex computer models are computationally expensive, and standard Gaussian process emulators struggle with global dimension reduction when the model has different low-dimensional structures in different parameter regimes.
summary_en.method: A clustered active subspace method is proposed that uses gradient-based clustering to identify local low-dimensional subspaces and constructs local Gaussian process emulators within each cluster.
summary_en.result: Numerical examples demonstrate that the proposed method effectively handles models with complex, piecewise low-dimensional structures.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on several numerical benchmark problems with known low-dimensional structures.

title: An adjoint‐assisted multilevel multifidelity method for uncertainty quantification and its application to turbomachinery manufacturing variability
venue: International Journal for Numerical Methods in Engineering
first_author_affiliation: ALGO‐COOP Team CERFACS  Toulouse France

corresponding_authors.name: Pavanakumar Mohanamuraly
corresponding_authors.affiliation: ALGO‐COOP Team CERFACS  Toulouse France

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多层级多保真度不确定性量化方法可迁移至植入物力学仿真中的高效采样与UQ问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant design, contact mechanics, or bone-implant interface; it focuses on turbomachinery aerodynamics.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效量化高维不确定参数下的计算成本问题
summary_zh.method: 提出基于伴随的多层级多保真度蒙特卡洛框架FastUQ
summary_zh.result: 相比MLMC方法，预测均值的计算成本降低70%
summary_zh.validation: 以涡轮叶片制造变差为案例进行仿真验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce computational cost of uncertainty quantification in problems with high-dimensional uncertain parameters.
summary_en.method: An adjoint-assisted multilevel multifidelity Monte Carlo framework (FastUQ) is proposed, using Inexpensive Monte Carlo as low-fidelity surrogate.
summary_en.result: The method achieves a 70% reduction in computational cost for predicting mean quantities compared to state-of-the-art MLMC.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a turbomachinery cascade with manufacturing variability using stochastic surface variation modeling.

key_terms.zh: 多层级多保真度蒙特卡洛

title: Using UncertainSCI to Quantify Uncertainty in Cardiac Simulations
first_author_affiliation: Department of Biomedical Engineering, University of Utah, SLC, UT, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Lindsay Rupp
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Biomedical Engineering, University of Utah, SLC, UT, USA

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的UQ框架可用于生物力学仿真中的参数不确定性量化，但未涉及植入物设计或接触力学。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on cardiac electrophysiology simulations, not on implant mechanics, stress shielding, or surrogate modeling for structural FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 心脏仿真中参数不确定性影响预测可靠性，需量化。
summary_zh.method: 开发UncertainSCI框架，基于多项式混沌展开构建随机仿真代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 成功量化心脏位置和组织电导率不确定性对躯干电位的影响。
summary_zh.validation: 通过边界元法和有限元法仿真案例验证框架有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Cardiac simulations often neglect parameter uncertainty, which undermines prediction reliability and clinical guidance.
summary_en.method: We developed UncertainSCI, a non-intrusive polynomial chaos expansion framework that efficiently builds surrogate models for stochastic simulations.
summary_en.result: The framework accurately quantified the sensitivity of torso potentials to uncertainties in heart position and tissue conductivities.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through two simulation cases: boundary element method for heart position uncertainty and finite element method for conductivity uncertainty.

title: Solid-Lattice Stem Optimization Design for Hip Implants
venue: International Journal of Engineering and Management Sciences
first_author_affiliation: No

corresponding_authors.name: Kleber Leonardo Castro Vera
corresponding_authors.affiliation: No

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及髋关节植入物优化，但未量化应力遮挡或微动，且缺乏实验验证。
why_not_core: No quantification of stress shielding in Gruen zones, no micromotion analysis with contact/friction modeling, and no comparison between intact and implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过拓扑和点阵优化减轻髋关节植入物质量。
summary_zh.method: 对四种优化方案（拓扑、100%/50%/25%点阵）施加五种载荷工况进行有限元分析。
summary_zh.result: 优化后质量减少2%-30%，满足屈服应力要求。
summary_zh.validation: 仅通过仿真验证，无实验或临床数据。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the mass of a Ti-6Al-4V hip implant while maintaining yield stress requirements through topology and lattice optimization.
summary_en.method: Four optimization cases (topology, 100%/50%/25% lattice) were analyzed under five load cases using finite element analysis.
summary_en.result: The optimized designs achieved mass reductions of 2% to 30% compared to the solid stem, all within yield stress limits.
summary_en.validation: Validation was limited to simulation; no experimental or clinical validation was performed.

corresponding_authors.name: Liang Yan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Nanjing Center for Applied Mathematics, Nanjing 211135, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种用于核插值的最优设计方法，可应用于不确定性量化，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的采样优化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on kernel interpolation design for general UQ, without application to FEA surrogate modeling or implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高核插值方法在不确定性量化中的采样效率
summary_zh.method: 提出基于信息论的最优设计准则，优化插值点位置
summary_zh.result: 在多个数值算例中验证了该方法相比传统采样策略的精度优势
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准数值基准测试验证方法性能

summary_en.motivation: To improve sampling efficiency for kernel interpolation methods in uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: An information-theoretic optimal design criterion is proposed to select interpolation points.
summary_en.result: The proposed method demonstrates superior accuracy over traditional sampling strategies on several numerical benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard numerical benchmark problems.

title: Fast covariance parameter estimation of spatial Gaussian process models using neural networks
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用神经网络加速高斯过程协方差参数估计，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on spatial statistics and climate science, not on FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 高斯过程协方差参数的最大似然估计计算成本高。
summary_zh.method: 训练神经网络以空间场或变差图为输入，直接输出协方差参数。
summary_zh.result: 神经网络估计精度与最大似然法相当，速度提升百倍以上。
summary_zh.validation: 在气候科学模拟数据上验证估计精度与速度。

summary_en.motivation: Maximum likelihood estimation of Gaussian process covariance parameters is computationally expensive, limiting its use in large-scale spatial data analysis.
summary_en.method: Neural networks are trained to take spatial fields or variograms as input and directly output range and noise-to-signal covariance parameters.
summary_en.result: The neural network estimates achieve similar accuracy to maximum likelihood estimation while being over 100 times faster.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic spatial fields motivated by a climate science application, comparing accuracy and speed against maximum likelihood.

why_not_core: This paper focuses on optical freeform surfaces, not biomedical or cell-laden bioprinting, and lacks any biological or clinical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高喷墨3D打印光学自由曲面的形貌精度
summary_zh.method: 构建数字孪生，集成测量数据反馈至打印过程

summary_en.motivation: To improve form fidelity of 3D inkjet-printed optical freeform surfaces by integrating measurement feedback.
summary_en.method: A digital twin is formulated by combining an optical model with geometrical measurement data, enabling iterative process adaptation.
summary_en.result: The feedback loop compensates for process errors and tolerances, demonstrated on a helical surface with adjustable optical power.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation of the manufactured component's performance compared to nominal design.

title: Deformation evolution and fracture mechanism of porous TC4 alloy scaffolds fabricated using selective laser melting under uniaxial compression

corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Materials Science and Engineering, North University of China, Taiyuan 030051, China

why_not_core: Does not address stress shielding, fatigue behavior, or surface/osseeintegration aspects, focusing only on static uniaxial compression.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究多孔TC4合金支架在压缩下的变形与断裂机制
summary_zh.method: SLM制备不同孔隙率支架并进行准静态压缩实验
summary_zh.result: 揭示了孔隙率对失效模式的影响，断裂始于支柱薄弱区域

summary_en.motivation: To understand the deformation and fracture behavior of porous Ti-6Al-4V scaffolds fabricated by selective laser melting under compressive loading.
summary_en.method: Scaffolds with varying porosities were produced via SLM and subjected to quasi-static uniaxial compression tests with in-situ imaging.
summary_en.result: Failure initiated at weak struts and propagated, with porosity dictating the transition from ductile to brittle fracture modes.
summary_en.validation: Experimental stress-strain curves and SEM fractography confirmed the observed failure mechanisms.

title: Computational analysis of the effects of geometric irregularities and post-processing steps on the mechanical behavior of additively manufactured 316L stainless steel stents
first_author_affiliation: Computational Mechanics and Materials Lab, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Ostbayerische Technische Hochschule (OTH) Regensburg, Regensburg, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Lisa Wiesent
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Computational Mechanics and Materials Lab, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Ostbayerische Technische Hochschule (OTH) Regensburg, Regensburg, Germany

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及激光粉末床熔融制造支架的力学性能，但与应力遮挡或骨植入物的关联度较低。
why_not_core: No stress shielding analysis, no bone-implant interface, no osseointegration or fatigue data for orthopedic implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究几何缺陷和后处理对激光粉末床熔融支架力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 结合实验与有限元模拟分析支架形态、径向力及膨胀行为。
summary_zh.result: 电解抛光后支架力学性能接近传统支架，但屈服强度因尺寸效应显著降低。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩实验和数值模拟对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates how process-related geometric irregularities and post-processing steps affect the morphology and mechanical behavior of laser powder bed fused 316L stainless steel stents.
summary_en.method: A combined experimental and computational framework was employed, using both actual and computationally reconstructed stents to evaluate their mechanical response and expansion.
summary_en.result: Electropolished stents exhibited radial forces comparable to conventional stents, while as-built and heat-treated stents showed increased stiffness and reduced yield strength due to size effects.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests and numerical simulations were used to validate the predicted macroscopic mechanical response.

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently quantify uncertainty in random fields using only spatially sparse measurement data.
summary_en.method: A synthesis of Bayesian compressive sensing and stochastic harmonic function is proposed to reconstruct random fields from sparse observations.
summary_en.result: The proposed method accurately captures the statistical characteristics of random fields even with limited data.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark examples demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the approach.

summary_en.result: Nitinol samples with a relative density exceeding 99% were successfully fabricated based on model predictions and experimental calibrations.

why_not_core: This paper focuses on soil hydrology and does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or structural FEA surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用现场实测数据反演土壤水力参数，避免实验室尺度不匹配问题。

summary_en.motivation: To estimate soil hydraulic properties from field-scale volumetric water content measurements without requiring initial and boundary conditions.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network framework with monotonicity constraints is proposed to inversely solve the Richardson-Richards equation and recover water retention curves and hydraulic conductivity functions.
summary_en.result: The PINN successfully reconstructs water content dynamics but shows limited accuracy at wet and dry ends due to strong nonlinearity.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using synthetic noisy data generated from numerical solutions for three soil textures.

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the bioactivity of selective laser melting manufactured porous Ti6Al4V scaffolds.
summary_en.method: Plasma electrolytic oxidation was employed to deposit a bio-functional coating on the porous scaffolds.
summary_en.result: A bioactive coating was successfully formed, but mechanical properties such as fatigue and stress shielding were not evaluated.
summary_en.validation: In vitro tests were conducted to assess biocompatibility of the coating.

why_not_core: This paper focuses on fiber composites rather than biomedical implants, and does not address implant-specific constraints or biomechanical design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 纤维复合材料微观结构不确定性影响宏观力学性能，需高效量化。
summary_zh.method: 基于显微图像提取微观结构参数，构建随机有限元模型进行非线性分析。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了微观结构不确定性对复合材料非线性响应的影响规律。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值模拟案例验证方法的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Microstructural uncertainties in fiber composites significantly affect macroscopic mechanical behavior, necessitating efficient quantification.
summary_en.method: Microstructural parameters are extracted from microscopy images and incorporated into stochastic finite element models for nonlinear analysis.
summary_en.result: The influence of microstructural uncertainties on the nonlinear response of composites is characterized.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated through numerical simulation cases.

title: High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization via Tree-Structured Additive Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种针对高维黑箱优化的树结构加性贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。

summary_zh.method: 采用树结构加性模型，结合吉布斯采样和变异进行结构学习，并提出连续域上的缩放算法。
summary_zh.result: 在合成函数和真实数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成函数和真实数据集上的实验进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To scale Bayesian optimization to high-dimensional problems while reducing computational cost and maintaining sample efficiency.
summary_en.method: The paper proposes tree-structured additive models with a hybrid graph learning algorithm using Gibbs sampling and mutation, and a zooming-based acquisition for continuous domains.
summary_en.result: The approach demonstrates improved efficiency on synthetic functions and real-world datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical benchmarks on synthetic functions and real-world datasets.

summary_zh.method: 扩展异方差不确定性估计至多输出机器学习代理模型。

summary_en.method: Extends heteroscedastic uncertainty estimation to multivariate-output machine learning emulators.
summary_en.result: Predictions are accurate within estimated errors, though uncertainty bounds are somewhat conservative.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks of high-strain brittle fracture simulations.

visual.caption: Figure 1 : In a standard NN each weight has a fixed value. In most BNN s all weights follow Gaussian distributions and are assumed to be mutually independent: each weight is factorized by a Gaussian distribution. summary_en.motivation: To review the manufacturing processes, surface topography, and osseointegration of 3D-printed customized dental implants.

title: Yield Optimization using Hybrid Gaussian Process Regression and a Genetic Multi-Objective Approach
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出结合高斯过程回归与多目标优化的混合方法，可转移至生物力学代理建模领域。

summary_en.motivation: To address the high computational cost of uncertainty quantification and optimization in electromagnetic device design.
summary_en.method: A hybrid approach combining Gaussian Process Regression surrogate model with Monte Carlo analysis and a genetic multi-objective optimization.
summary_en.result: The proposed methods outperform classic approaches on a dielectric waveguide benchmark problem.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a numerical benchmark problem of a dielectric waveguide.

title: Microstructure, mechanical properties, corrosion resistance and cytocompatibility of WE43 Mg alloy scaffolds fabricated by laser powder bed fusion for biomedical applications

summary_zh.motivation: 为可降解骨植入物制造WE43镁合金多孔支架，评估其性能。

summary_zh.validation: 通过X射线显微CT、SEM、力学测试和体外细胞实验验证。

summary_en.result: Detected strong interactions among friction coefficients, especially where flow height and velocity variation are small.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed by applying the method to the 2017 Bondo landslide event.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的结合高斯过程代理的数据一致反演方法可用于生物力学植入物设计中昂贵的有限元仿真采样效率提升和不确定性量化。

summary_en.method: Combines data-consistent inversion with Gaussian process surrogate to replace expensive CPFEM.

title: High-Dimensional Uncertainty Quantification via Active and Rank-Adaptive Tensor Regression
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过主动学习和秩自适应张量回归解决高维不确定性量化中的采样效率问题，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型。

summary_zh.motivation: 高维不确定性量化中采样效率低且张量秩难以自动确定。

summary_en.motivation: Stochastic spectral methods for uncertainty quantification suffer from the curse of dimensionality, and existing low-rank tensor approaches require manual rank selection and inefficient sampling.

summary_en.result: The method accurately captures high-dimensional uncertainty on a 19-dim filter and a 57-dim oscillator using only 90 and 290 samples, respectively.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on two high-dimensional electronic circuit benchmarks with known reference solutions.

summary_zh.method: 结合最大熵方法、分数阶统计矩和乘性降维技术估计寿命概率分布
summary_zh.result: 仅需80次函数评估即可获得与蒙特卡洛模拟相当的精度
summary_zh.validation: 在球轴承的有限元分析和非线性解析模型上验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of expensive function evaluations in high-fidelity fatigue life prediction.
summary_en.method: A statistical framework combining Maximum Entropy Method, fractional statistical moments, and Multiplicative Dimensional Reduction to estimate probability distributions of fatigue life.
summary_en.result: Achieved accuracy comparable to Monte Carlo simulation with only 80 function evaluations, an order of magnitude fewer.
summary_en.validation: Validated on finite element analysis and nonlinear analytical models of a 6204 SKF ball bearing.

title: Semi-Supervised Deep Learning for High-Dimensional Uncertainty Quantification

corresponding_authors.name: Zequn Wang

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种半监督深度学习框架用于高维不确定性量化，其降维和代理建模方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的高维随机问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or implant biomechanics; it only demonstrates on a mathematical example without physical simulation or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统不确定性量化方法难以处理高维问题，需要降维和高效代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 采用自编码器降维，结合深度前馈网络和高斯过程构建半监督学习框架。
summary_zh.result: 在数学算例中验证了框架对高维可靠性分析的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过一个数学算例进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional uncertainty quantification methods suffer from the curse of dimensionality, necessitating dimension reduction and efficient surrogate modeling.
summary_en.method: An autoencoder maps high-dimensional space to a low-dimensional latent space, then a deep feedforward neural network with Gaussian process surrogate is trained via semi-supervised learning using both labeled and unlabeled samples.
summary_en.result: The proposed framework demonstrates effectiveness for high-dimensional reliability analysis on a mathematical example.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a numerical benchmark mathematical example.

title: Scalable Objective-Driven Batch Sampling in Simulation-Based Design for Models With Heteroscedastic Noise
first_author_affiliation: Northwestern University

corresponding_authors.name: Anton van Beek
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Northwestern University

why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant mechanics, lacks uncertainty quantification for point predictions, and does not handle multi-objective or constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 随机仿真模型优化中，输入依赖噪声和计算成本高的问题亟待解决。
summary_zh.method: 提出可扩展的批量自适应采样算法，通过复制和探索策略平衡预测精度与计算效率。
summary_zh.result: 在数值测试和工程问题中，可靠高效地找到全局最优解。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个数值测试函数和一个实际工程问题验证算法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Optimizing stochastic simulation models with input-dependent noise remains challenging due to high computational cost and heteroscedasticity.
summary_en.method: A scalable batch adaptive sampling scheme is proposed that decides between replicating at observed locations and exploring new ones to minimize posterior prediction error near the global optimum.
summary_en.result: The method reliably and efficiently finds the global optimum on two numerical test functions and one real engineering problem.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks and a real engineering problem, demonstrating effectiveness for stochastic models.

title: Parametric Design Optimization in Computational Aerodynamics using Artificial Deep Neural Networks

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of evaluating large design spaces in CFD-based design optimization.
summary_en.method: A surrogate model using artificial neural networks is trained on CFD data to replace expensive simulations, enabling rapid evaluation of billions of designs.
summary_en.result: The ANN surrogate finds a globally superior compressor design compared to genetic algorithms with the same number of design evaluations, drastically reducing design time.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on a diffuser airfoil shape optimization problem for a centrifugal compressor, comparing against genetic algorithms.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化弹性梁在制造误差下的后屈曲形状，提高性能鲁棒性。
summary_zh.method: 采用贝叶斯优化与新型采集函数，考虑几何不确定性进行设计。

summary_zh.validation: 通过蒙特卡洛模拟比较优化结果，验证鲁棒性。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize the post-buckling shape of elastomeric beams under manufacturing-induced geometric uncertainty for consistent performance.
summary_en.method: Bayesian optimization with a novel acquisition function that accounts for robustness to profile error is applied to a Fourier series-based design parameterization.
summary_en.result: The robust acquisition function yields designs that achieve desired performance consistently despite geometric variability from additive manufacturing.
summary_en.validation: Monte Carlo simulations quantify performance variability and demonstrate the advantage of the proposed robust optimization approach.

title: Bayesian Optimization for Simulation-Based Design of Multi-Model Systems

summary_zh.method: 提出多模型贝叶斯优化，动态选择子模型评估，使用链接代理和系统知识梯度采集函数。
summary_zh.result: 在解析问题和电子封装优化问题中验证了效率提升。
summary_zh.validation: 通过解析算例和电子封装多学科设计问题验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing Bayesian optimization for multi-model systems treats all component models as a single expensive model, leading to inefficiency.
summary_en.method: A multi-model Bayesian optimization approach is proposed that dynamically selects one component model per iteration using linked emulators for uncertainty quantification and the system knowledge gradient acquisition function.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates superior efficiency on an analytical problem and a multidisciplinary electronic packaging optimization problem.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical benchmarks: an analytical problem and a multidisciplinary design optimization case.

title: An Approach to Bayesian Optimization for Design Feasibility Check on Discontinuous Black-Box Functions
first_author_affiliation: Oregon State University

corresponding_authors.name: Arpan Biswas
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Oregon State University

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种贝叶斯优化方法用于处理不连续黑箱函数的可行性约束，可迁移至植入物设计中的约束优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive FEA simulations, lacks uncertainty quantification, and is not applied to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化通常假设连续目标函数，无法处理不连续约束边界。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种BO框架，通过最大化重构目标函数来预测可行/不可行区域的过渡边界。
summary_zh.result: 在薄管设计中，分类误差率低于1%，函数评估次数约150次。
summary_zh.validation: 与真实解对比分类误差率和函数评估次数。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization typically assumes continuous objective functions and fails to handle discontinuous constraint boundaries.
summary_en.method: A BO framework is proposed that predicts the transition boundary between feasible and infeasible regions by maximizing a reformulated objective function.
summary_en.result: On a thin tube design problem, the classification error rate is below 1% with approximately 150 function evaluations.
summary_en.validation: The converged model is compared with the true solution in terms of classification error rate and number of function evaluations.

summary_en.method: The proposed method transforms the multi-objective problem into a single-objective one using weighted sum or min-max aggregation, training only one surrogate model.
summary_en.result: The approach achieves comparable or superior Pareto fronts on four test problems, including the design of a sandwich composite armor for blast mitigation.

summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmark problems.

title: Efficient sampling for polynomial chaos-based uncertainty quantification and sensitivity analysis using weighted approximate Fekete points
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的采样方法用于多项式混沌展开的不确定度量化，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的采样优化。

summary_en.motivation: To improve computational efficiency of uncertainty quantification and sensitivity analysis in patient-specific physiological models.
summary_en.method: Weighted approximate Fekete points (WAFP) are used for least-squares polynomial approximation to construct polynomial chaos expansions.

summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via stochastic simulation of a cardiovascular oxyhemoglobin dissociation response model.

summary_en.motivation: There is a lack of systematic studies on the effect of hyperparameters on the accuracy and robustness of surrogate models in engineering design.
summary_en.method: A hyperparameter optimization framework was proposed and tested on four machine learning algorithms (GPR, SVM, RFR, ANN) using four benchmark examples.
summary_en.result: Hyperparameter optimization generally improves model performance, but yields limited gains for complex problems with high-dimensional mixed-variable design spaces.
summary_en.validation: The approach was validated on four numerical benchmark problems of varying complexity.

title: Uncertainty quantification of viscoelastic parameters in arterial hemodynamics with the a-FSI blood flow model
relevance_to_user: 该论文将不确定性量化方法应用于动脉血流动力学中的粘弹性参数，其方法可迁移至植入物力学仿真中的参数不确定性分析。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, bone-implant interface mechanics, or surrogate modeling for expensive FEA simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化动脉血流模型中壁面粘弹性参数的不确定性
summary_zh.method: 采用随机配置法和IMEX有限体积格式求解随机一维血流模型
summary_zh.result: 粘弹性参数的不确定性显著影响压力波形预测的置信区间
summary_zh.validation: 通过模型方程收敛性验证和患者数据对比确认方法有效性

summary_en.motivation: To identify and quantify uncertainties in elastic and viscoelastic parameters characterizing arterial wall behavior in one-dimensional hemodynamic modeling.
summary_en.method: A stochastic collocation method combined with an IMEX finite volume scheme is employed to solve the stochastic system of governing equations with Gaussian-distributed random parameters.
summary_en.result: The viscoelastic parameter uncertainty significantly enlarges the confidence interval of pressure waveforms, while flow rate and velocity show less sensitivity.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through a convergence study on a model equation and by comparing simulated pressure waveforms with in-vivo patient-specific data.

title: Gaussian Process Regression with Local Explanation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种可解释的高斯过程回归方法，其不确定性量化能力可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但未涉及FEA或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling or optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 高斯过程回归缺乏可解释性，需揭示特征对预测的贡献。
summary_zh.method: 提出局部线性模型，权重由多元高斯过程先验生成，闭式求解。
summary_zh.result: 预测性能与GPR相当，可解释性优于现有模型。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个基准数据集上定量和定性验证。

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian process regression lacks interpretability, motivating a method to reveal feature contributions per sample.
summary_en.method: A locally linear model with weights drawn from multivariate Gaussian process priors, enabling closed-form prediction and explanation.
summary_en.result: The proposed model achieves predictive performance comparable to standard GPR and superior interpretability on benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Quantitative and qualitative evaluation on multiple benchmark datasets.

title: Uncertainty Prediction for Deep Sequential Regression Using Meta Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的不确定性预测方法可迁移至代理模型中的不确定性量化，但未涉及有限元或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on sequential regression uncertainty without physical simulation context.

summary_zh.motivation: 深度序列回归中不确定性估计困难，现有方法假设过强且性能差。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种灵活元模型方法，可生成对称和非对称不确定性估计，无需平稳性假设。
summary_zh.result: 在漂移和非漂移场景下均优于基线方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准基准数据集上对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Generating reliable uncertainty estimates for deep sequential regression remains challenging due to restrictive assumptions like stationarity.
summary_en.method: A flexible meta-modeling approach is proposed to produce symmetric and asymmetric uncertainty intervals without stationarity assumptions.
summary_en.result: The method outperforms competitive baselines on both drift and non-drift scenarios.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard benchmark datasets for sequential regression.

title: The Migration Pattern of a Cementless Hydroxyapatite-Coated Titanium Stem under Immediate Full Weight-Bearing-A Randomized Controlled Trial Using Model-Based RSA.

why_not_core: No finite element modeling, no stress/strain quantification, no contact mechanics, and no comparison of intact vs implanted femur.

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the early migration pattern of a cementless hydroxyapatite-coated femoral stem under immediate full weight-bearing after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A randomized controlled trial using model-based radiostereometric analysis (RSA) at multiple postoperative time points.
summary_en.result: Stem subsidence occurred predominantly within the first six weeks, with subsequent osseointegration and no further migration at two years.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation with 44 patients and two-year RSA follow-up data.

summary_en.motivation: To improve sampling efficiency in system reliability-based design optimization where multiple failure modes require expensive simulations.
summary_en.method: A composite active learning Kriging method is proposed that adaptively selects samples by considering multiple failure modes simultaneously.
summary_en.result: The method significantly reduces the number of function evaluations while maintaining accuracy in numerical benchmark problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on several numerical benchmark problems with known analytical solutions.

summary_zh.validation: 在四个实验数据集上验证不同估计器的性能

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the efficiency of different uncertainty estimators in active learning loops for accelerating materials discovery.
summary_en.method: A bootstrap approach with support vector regression as base learner is used to obtain prediction uncertainties, comparing empirical standard error and jackknife-based estimators.
summary_en.result: The empirical standard error estimator yields variance estimates closest to the true variance with small bootstrap replicates, requiring the fewest active learning iterations to find the optimal material.
summary_en.validation: Validated on four experimental materials datasets, demonstrating the impact of bootstrap replicate number on optimization efficiency.

title: BOSH: Bayesian Optimization by Sampling Hierarchically
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种处理随机目标函数的贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanical implant design; it focuses on general BO for noisy functions.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准贝叶斯优化忽略真实目标函数，导致高精度优化错误函数。
summary_zh.method: 提出BOSH框架，结合层次高斯过程和信息论，动态生成样本池。
summary_zh.result: 在合成基准、仿真优化、强化学习和超参数调优中表现更高效、高精度。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个数值基准和实际任务上验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Bayesian Optimization optimizes an average of noisy realizations, ignoring the true objective and yielding suboptimal high-precision solutions.
summary_en.method: BOSH pairs a hierarchical Gaussian process with an information-theoretic acquisition to dynamically grow the pool of realizations during optimization.
summary_en.result: BOSH achieves more efficient and higher-precision optimization than standard BO across synthetic benchmarks, simulation optimization, RL, and hyperparameter tuning.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks and real-world tasks including simulation optimization and reinforcement learning.

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently quantify uncertainty in mode shape variation of structures under uncertainty, avoiding expensive Monte Carlo simulations.

summary_en.result: The proposed method accurately and efficiently predicts mode shape variation under structural uncertainty.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through comprehensive case studies comparing surrogate predictions with direct simulations.

title: Uncertainty Quantification Neural Network from Similarity and Sensitivity

why_not_core: This paper does not apply the UQ method to FEA surrogate modeling or biomedical implant design; it is validated on generic regression datasets without structural mechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有基于相似性的不确定性量化方法易受无关事件影响，需要更鲁棒的UQ方法。
summary_zh.method: 先训练点预测神经网络获取输入敏感性，基于敏感性设置参数范围，选择相似事件并训练边界校正网络。
summary_zh.result: 提出的方法提供了公平且领域无关的不确定性边界，最终可直接用神经网络输出不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个基准数据集上验证，并与传统方法对比。

summary_en.motivation: Similarity-based uncertainty quantification suffers from irrelevant events, motivating a more robust approach incorporating input sensitivity.
summary_en.method: A neural network is first trained for point prediction to obtain input sensitivity; then similar events are selected with adaptive ranges based on sensitivity, and a bound-correction network is trained to refine uncertainty bounds.
summary_en.result: The proposed method yields fair and domain-independent uncertainty bounds, and a final neural network can directly output these bounds without the full process.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on multiple benchmark regression datasets, demonstrating improved uncertainty estimates over baseline similarity-based methods.

summary_en.result: MiVaBo achieves significantly higher sample efficiency than state-of-the-art mixed-variable BO algorithms on several hyperparameter tuning tasks, including deep generative model tuning.

title: Learning Search Space Partition for Black-box Optimization using Monte Carlo Tree Search

summary_en.motivation: High-dimensional black-box optimization suffers from the curse of dimensionality, limiting sample efficiency of global models like Bayesian Optimization.

summary_en.result: The method achieves strong performance on general black-box optimization and reinforcement learning benchmarks, especially for high-dimensional problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic and real-world benchmark functions, comparing against Bayesian Optimization and TuRBO.

corresponding_authors.name: Mahdi Imani
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, George Washington University

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯优化与MOCU结合框架可扩展到大规模设计空间，对生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样效率问题具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on gene regulatory network intervention design, not on FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification for structural mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有MOCU实验设计框架无法扩展到大规模设计空间
summary_zh.method: 结合贝叶斯优化与MOCU策略实现可扩展的实验设计
summary_zh.result: 新框架在基因调控网络结构干预设计中展示了可靠性、可扩展性和效率
summary_zh.validation: 通过基因调控网络最优结构干预的仿真案例验证

summary_en.motivation: The existing MOCU-based experimental design framework lacks scalability to large design spaces.
summary_en.method: A framework combining Bayesian optimization with the MOCU policy is proposed to enable experimental design in much larger design spaces.
summary_en.result: The proposed framework demonstrates reliability, scalability, and efficiency in experimental design for optimal structural intervention in gene regulatory networks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation case studies on optimal structural intervention in gene regulatory networks.

key_terms.zh: 平均目标成本不确定性

title: A surrogate model for computational homogenization of elastostatics at finite strain using high‐dimensional model representation‐based neural network
venue: International Journal for Numerical Methods in Engineering
first_author_affiliation: Chair of Computational Science and Simulation Technology, Department of Mathematics and Physics Leibniz Universität Hannover  Hannover Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Timon Rabczuk
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Research and Development Duy Tan University  Da Nang Vietnam

corresponding_authors.name: Xiaoying Zhuang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Chair of Computational Science and Simulation Technology, Department of Mathematics and Physics Leibniz Universität Hannover  Hannover Germany

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于HDMR神经网络的代理模型用于有限应变下的计算均质化，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的多尺度模拟加速。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant-specific biomechanics, stress shielding, or patient-specific geometry; it focuses on computational homogenization of elastostatics at finite strain without uncertainty quantification or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速有限应变下两尺度计算均质化，避免昂贵微观有限元求解
summary_zh.method: 采用模仿高维模型表示的神经网络构建宏观能量密度代理模型
summary_zh.result: 离线训练后在线计算效率显著提升，微观问题使用FFT方法避免固定点迭代
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准算例验证代理模型精度

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate two-scale computational homogenization of elastostatics at finite strains by replacing costly microscopic finite element solves with a surrogate model.
summary_en.method: A neural network architecture mimicking high-dimensional model representation (HDMR) is used to construct an explicit macroscopic energy density from microscopic boundary value problem data.
summary_en.result: The offline-trained surrogate enables efficient online macroscale finite element simulations, with microscopic equilibrium solved via an FFT-based collocation method that avoids fixed-point iteration.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark examples demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed surrogate model.

title: Overview of Gaussian process based multi-fidelity techniques with variable relationship between fidelities
relevance_to_user: 该论文综述了高斯过程多保真建模技术，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真替代建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant-specific biomechanics, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification in the context of surrogate-based design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 多保真建模中不同保真度模型间关系复杂，需系统综述GP方法。
summary_zh.method: 统一框架下描述多种GP多保真技术，并数值比较。
summary_zh.result: 不同方法在分析测试和航空工程问题上表现各异，取决于问题特征。
summary_zh.validation: 通过解析测试和四个航空工程案例数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Multi-fidelity modeling requires handling variable relationships between fidelity levels, motivating a systematic review of Gaussian process-based techniques.
summary_en.method: Various GP-based multi-fidelity methods are described within a unified framework and compared on analytical and aerospace engineering problems.
summary_en.result: The performance of each method depends on problem characteristics such as linearity and correlation between fidelities.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on analytical test cases and four aerospace engineering problems.

title: On the use of Nonlinear Normal Modes for Nonlinear Reduced Order Modelling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出基于非线性模态的降阶方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and no validation on implant or biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 非线性系统仿真计算成本高，需要高效降阶方法。
summary_zh.method: 利用机器学习从输出数据提取非线性模态，构建降阶模型。
summary_zh.result: 在20自由度非线性系统上验证了方法的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 数值仿真案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Nonlinear numerical analysis remains computationally expensive for tasks like uncertainty quantification, motivating efficient reduced order models.
summary_en.method: Nonlinear normal modes are extracted from output-only data using machine learning and used as an invertible reduction basis for nonlinear systems.
summary_en.result: The proposed NNM-based reduced order model is demonstrated on a simulated 20-degree-of-freedom nonlinear system.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via a numerical simulation case of a nonlinear 20-DOF system.

title: Generalized Polynomial Chaos Expansion for Fast and Accurate Uncertainty Quantification in Geomechanical Modelling
first_author_affiliation: Department of Civil, Environmental and Architectural Engineering, University of Padova, 35131 Padova, Italy

corresponding_authors.name: Claudia Zoccarato
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Civil, Environmental and Architectural Engineering, University of Padova, 35131 Padova, Italy

relevance_to_user: 该论文使用广义多项式混沌展开(gPCE)作为替代模型进行不确定性量化和敏感性分析，方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper applies gPCE to geomechanical modelling of hydrocarbon reservoirs, not to biomedical implant or biomechanics FEA, and lacks experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 地质力学模拟中不确定性量化计算成本高，需高效替代模型。
summary_zh.method: 采用广义多项式混沌展开(gPCE)构建替代模型，结合集合平滑器进行数据同化。
summary_zh.result: gPCE替代模型大幅降低计算成本，同时提高预测精度。
summary_zh.validation: 基于三维有限元合成油藏案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Uncertainty quantification in geomechanical modeling is computationally expensive, necessitating efficient surrogate models.
summary_en.method: A generalized Polynomial Chaos Expansion (gPCE) surrogate is proposed to approximate the forward problem and integrated with Ensemble Smoother for data assimilation.
summary_en.result: The gPCE surrogate significantly reduces computational cost while improving prediction accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a synthetic 3-D finite element model of a deep hydrocarbon reservoir.

title: Fast spot-scanning proton dose calculation method with uncertainty quantification using a three-dimensional convolutional neural network
first_author_affiliation: Department of Radiation Medical Science and Engineering, Faculty of Medicine, Hokkaido University, Sapporo 060-8638, Japan

corresponding_authors.name: Yusuke Nomura
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Radiation Medical Science and Engineering, Faculty of Medicine, Hokkaido University, Sapporo 060-8638, Japan

relevance_to_user: 该论文使用3D-CNN进行质子剂量计算并量化不确定性，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on proton dose calculation in radiotherapy, not on FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics or structural mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现快速且具有不确定性估计的质子剂量计算。
summary_zh.method: 使用3D-CNN以CT图像和峰值图作为输入，预测质子剂量分布。
summary_zh.result: 模型在0.8秒内完成剂量计算，平均绝对误差0.778 cGyE。
summary_zh.validation: 基于215例头颈癌患者的公开数据集进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve near-real-time proton dose calculation with probabilistic uncertainty estimation for spot-scanning proton therapy.
summary_en.method: A 3D convolutional neural network is trained on CT images and peak maps to predict single-field uniform dose distributions, with transfer learning for adaptation to different beam parameters.
summary_en.result: The model computes 3D dose distributions in about 0.8 seconds with a mean absolute error of 0.778 cGyE, and predicted uncertainty correlates with dose errors at high-contrast edges.
summary_en.validation: Numerical validation on a public dataset of 215 head and neck cancer patients using 1484 training and 488 testing plans.

title: Conformal Prediction Intervals for Neural Networks Using Cross Validation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于交叉验证的共形预测区间方法可直接迁移至代理模型的不确定性量化，提升植入物设计中的预测可靠性。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or biomechanical implant design, and lacks validation on engineering simulation data.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经网络仅输出点预测，缺乏可靠的预测区间。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于k折交叉验证的共形预测区间方法，利用交叉验证残差构建区间。
summary_zh.result: 相比分裂共形法，该方法在保持覆盖概率的同时生成更窄的预测区间。
summary_zh.validation: 通过模拟研究和10个真实数据集验证区间性能。

summary_en.motivation: Neural networks typically provide point predictions without reliable prediction intervals, limiting their use in risk-sensitive applications.
summary_en.method: A k-fold cross-validation-based conformal prediction method is proposed to construct prediction intervals for neural networks using residuals from cross-validation.
summary_en.result: The proposed method yields narrower prediction intervals than the split conformal method while maintaining the same coverage probability, especially advantageous with limited training data.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation studies and analysis of 10 real datasets, comparing interval width and coverage with competing methods.

title: The effect of HF-HNO3 chemical polishing on the surface roughness and fatigue life of laser powder bed fusion produced Ti6Al4V
first_author_affiliation: Department of Industrial Engineering, Stellenbosch University, Stellenbosch, 7600, South Africa

corresponding_authors.name: Martin Bezuidenhout
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Industrial Engineering, Stellenbosch University, Stellenbosch, 7600, South Africa

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了LPBF Ti6Al4V的化学抛光对表面粗糙度和疲劳寿命的影响，与用户关注的增材制造生物医学植入物的力学性能相关，但未涉及多孔结构或应力遮挡。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, or osseointegration, which are core to the user's direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究化学抛光对LPBF Ti6Al4V表面粗糙度和疲劳性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用HF-HNO3化学抛光处理，测试表面粗糙度和疲劳寿命
summary_zh.result: 化学抛光显著降低表面粗糙度并提高疲劳寿命
summary_zh.validation: 通过疲劳测试和表面形貌表征验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of HF-HNO3 chemical polishing on the surface roughness and fatigue life of laser powder bed fusion produced Ti6Al4V.
summary_en.method: Chemical polishing with HF-HNO3 solution was applied to LPBF Ti6Al4V specimens, followed by surface roughness measurement and fatigue testing.
summary_en.result: Chemical polishing significantly reduced surface roughness and improved fatigue life.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through fatigue testing and surface morphology characterization.

title: Multi-fidelity modeling with different input domain definitions using Deep Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多保真度深度高斯过程方法可处理不同输入域，有望迁移至植入物力学代理建模中，提高采样效率并处理约束。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant design problems, lacks uncertainty quantification for design optimization, and does not address constraints or multi-objective scenarios.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有多保真度方法假设各保真度输入域相同，限制了实际应用。
summary_zh.method: 扩展深度高斯过程，允许不同保真度使用不同参数化输入。
summary_zh.result: 在解析测试和结构/气动问题上验证了方法的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过解析算例和工程问题数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing multi-fidelity methods assume identical input domains across fidelities, limiting their applicability when low-fidelity models use simplified or different parametrizations.
summary_en.method: The paper extends Deep Gaussian Processes for multi-fidelity modeling to handle cases where each fidelity level has a different input domain definition.
summary_en.result: The proposed method demonstrates improved prediction accuracy on analytical test cases and real structural and aerodynamic problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on analytical benchmarks and two engineering problems (structural and aerodynamic).

title: Estimates on the generalization error of Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) for approximating a class of inverse problems for PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文为PINN求解逆问题提供了严格的泛化误差理论，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计中的约束处理与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on theoretical error bounds for PINNs in inverse PDE problems, but does not address multi-objective constrained optimization, uncertainty quantification, or transferability to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 为PINN求解逆问题提供严格的泛化误差理论保证
summary_zh.method: 利用条件稳定性估计推导PINN泛化误差上界
summary_zh.result: 建立了抽象框架并在四个典型线性PDE上验证
summary_zh.validation: 数值实验验证理论估计

summary_en.motivation: To provide rigorous generalization error bounds for PINNs applied to a class of inverse PDE problems.
summary_en.method: Leverages conditional stability estimates of the inverse problem to derive an upper bound on the PINN generalization error.
summary_en.result: An abstract framework is established and validated on four prototypical linear PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments confirm the theoretical error estimates.

title: Estimates on the generalization error of Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) for approximating PDEs II: A class of inverse problems.
relevance_to_user: 该论文为PINN求解逆问题提供了泛化误差的理论保证，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计中的约束处理与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on theoretical error bounds for inverse problems in PDEs, but does not address expensive simulation sampling, multi-objective constraints, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics/implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 为PINN求解逆问题提供严格的泛化误差理论保证。
summary_zh.method: 利用条件稳定性估计推导PINN泛化误差界，并在线性PDE上验证。
summary_zh.result: 建立了逆问题PINN泛化误差的理论框架，数值实验支持理论。
summary_zh.validation: 在四种典型线性PDE上进行了数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: To provide rigorous theoretical guarantees on the generalization error of PINNs for solving inverse problems in PDEs.
summary_en.method: An abstract framework is developed using conditional stability estimates of the inverse problem to bound the PINN generalization error, illustrated with four linear PDEs.
summary_en.result: Theoretical error bounds are established and validated through numerical experiments on prototypical linear PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on four linear PDEs confirm the theoretical estimates.

title: Efficient Nonmyopic Bayesian Optimization via One-Shot Multi-Step Trees
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的多步贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for implant biomechanics; it focuses on general black-box optimization without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有贝叶斯优化方法多为短视策略，忽略长期影响。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种单次多步树方法，将嵌套优化转化为联合优化。
summary_zh.result: 多步期望改进方法计算可行且性能优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准基准函数上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing Bayesian optimization methods are mostly myopic and ignore the long-term impact of immediate decisions.
summary_en.method: This paper proposes a one-shot multi-step tree approach that jointly optimizes all decision variables in the full tree, avoiding nested optimization.
summary_en.result: Multi-step expected improvement is computationally tractable and outperforms existing methods on a wide range of benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on multiple standard benchmark functions.

title: Mechanical Evaluation Of Selective Laser Melted Ni-Rich Niti: Compression, Tension, And Torsion
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制备的NiTi合金在不同载荷下的力学性能，但未涉及多孔结构或应力遮挡，且未针对生物医学植入物进行疲劳测试。
why_not_core: No porous structure, no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, no fatigue testing, and no surface roughness or osseointegration characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制备NiTi合金在不同载荷下的力学行为不对称性
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备Ni50.8Ti样品，进行压缩、拉伸和扭转测试，并用DIC监测应变场
summary_zh.result: 三种载荷下均出现局部应变，且力学行为显著不对称
summary_zh.validation: 通过DIC实验验证应变分布

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the asymmetric mechanical behavior of SLM-fabricated NiTi shape memory alloy under different loading conditions.
summary_en.method: Ni50.8Ti (at.%) samples were fabricated by SLM and tested under compression, tension, and torsion with in-situ DIC strain monitoring.
summary_en.result: Localized strain was observed in all loading modes, and significant asymmetric mechanical response was demonstrated.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation via DIC strain field measurement during mechanical tests.

title: Active learning method combining Kriging model and multimodal‐optimization‐based importance sampling for the estimation of small failure probability
venue: International Journal for Numerical Methods in Engineering
first_author_affiliation: School of Mechanical Engineering Southwest Jiaotong University  Chengdu PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Xufeng Yang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical Engineering Southwest Jiaotong University  Chengdu PR China

relevance_to_user: 该方法结合主动学习Kriging与多模态优化重要性采样，可高效估计小失效概率，适用于生物力学植入物设计的可靠性分析。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on structural reliability with small failure probabilities and multiple failure regions, but does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or patient-specific geometry constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决小失效概率和多失效区域下的可靠性分析效率问题
summary_zh.method: 提出主动学习Kriging与多模态优化重要性采样结合的方法
summary_zh.result: 通过六个案例验证了方法在精度和效率上的优势
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently estimate small failure probabilities in problems with multiple failure regions using a surrogate model.
summary_en.method: An active learning Kriging model is combined with multimodal optimization-based importance sampling to iteratively refine the surrogate limit state surface.
summary_en.result: The proposed method accurately estimates small failure probabilities while reducing the number of expensive function evaluations.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on six numerical benchmark cases with known failure probabilities.

title: Data-Driven Topology Optimization with Multiclass Microstructures using Latent Variable Gaussian Process
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多响应潜变量高斯过程模型可处理混合变量（微观结构类别与设计参数），对多尺度拓扑优化中的代理建模有参考价值，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context; no uncertainty quantification; no experimental validation; focuses on multiscale topology optimization with microstructures, not on surrogate modeling for expensive FEA in biomedical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有数据驱动拓扑优化仅考虑单一微观结构，无法处理多类微观结构间的无序性。
summary_zh.method: 提出多响应潜变量高斯过程模型，将微观结构类别与设计参数嵌入连续空间。
summary_zh.result: 多类微观结构可改善多尺度拓扑优化性能，实现载荷传递路径一致。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多尺度拓扑优化算例验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Existing data-driven topology optimization methods only handle a single class of microstructures, lacking the ability to incorporate multiple classes with no inherent ordering.
summary_en.method: A multi-response latent variable Gaussian process (MR-LVGP) model is developed to embed both qualitative microstructure concepts and quantitative design variables into a continuous latent space.
summary_en.result: Incorporating multiclass microstructures improves multiscale topology optimization performance by ensuring consistent load-transfer paths across scales.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through multiscale topology optimization examples with aperiodic microstructures.

title: Unlabelled Data Improves Bayesian Uncertainty Calibration under Covariate Shift
relevance_to_user: 该方法利用无标签数据改善贝叶斯神经网络在协变量偏移下的不确定性校准，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any structural/mechanical simulation context.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯神经网络在协变量偏移下预测过于自信，需要改进不确定性校准。
summary_zh.method: 利用无标签目标数据作为伪标签，通过后验正则化约束模型损失。
summary_zh.result: 显著提升了协变量偏移数据集上的不确定性量化准确性。
summary_zh.validation: 在跨人群前列腺癌预后模型迁移任务上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian neural networks exhibit over-confidence under covariate shift, necessitating improved uncertainty calibration.
summary_en.method: Unlabelled target data are used as pseudo-labels of model confidence to regularize the loss on labelled source data via posterior regularization.
summary_en.result: The approach significantly improves uncertainty quantification accuracy on covariate-shifted datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validated on transferring prognostic models of prostate cancer across globally diverse populations.

title: [Finite element analysis of different diameter prosthesis ball head in artificial femoral head replacement].
venue: Zhongguo gu shang = China journal of orthopaedics and traumatology
first_author_affiliation: Huamei Hospital, University of Chinese Academy of Science, Ningbo 315010, Zhejiang, China.

corresponding_authors.name: Xiao Yu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Huamei Hospital, University of Chinese Academy of Science, Ningbo 315010, Zhejiang, China.

relevance_to_user: 该论文通过有限元分析研究了不同股骨头假体直径对髋关节生物力学的影响，但未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或微动，与用户关注的股骨柄方向相关性较弱。
why_not_core: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain in Gruen zones, does not report micromotion with contact/friction modeling, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur for femoral stem evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 选择合适的人工股骨头假体球头直径，以恢复髋关节自然力学特性。
summary_zh.method: 利用薄层CT数据建立不同球头直径的人工股骨头置换三维有限元模型，模拟单足站立加载。
summary_zh.result: 球头直径比原股骨头小1 mm时，骨盆和髋臼应力最接近术前，应力遮挡最小。
summary_zh.validation: 仅通过有限元模拟对比不同模型间应力分布，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To select the optimal prosthetic ball head diameter for femoral head replacement that best restores the natural biomechanics of the hip joint.

title: Bayesian Optimization with a Prior for the Optimum
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的BOPrO方法通过注入最优先验加速贝叶斯优化，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian Optimization wastes evaluations on poor designs because it cannot incorporate expert knowledge about promising regions.

summary_en.result: BOPrO achieves 6.67x speedup over state-of-the-art on benchmarks and sets a new record on a real-world hardware design task.

summary_en.motivation: Existing acquisition functions for multi-task Bayesian optimization are computationally prohibitive, limiting their applicability to low-dimensional problems.
summary_en.method: We derive a novel multi-task entropy search acquisition function, MUMBO, that achieves low computational overhead while maintaining robust performance.
summary_en.result: MUMBO outperforms previous methods on classic optimization benchmarks and multi-task hyperparameter tuning tasks with significantly reduced optimization overhead.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on synthetic functions and hyperparameter tuning benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 多查询问题（如UQ）中全阶模型计算成本高，需高效降阶模型。

summary_en.motivation: Multiquery problems such as uncertainty quantification require solving differential equations at many parameter values, making full-order models computationally prohibitive.

summary_en.validation: The method is validated on two numerical benchmarks: the viscous Burgers' equation and a beam on nonlinear Winkler foundation.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维贝叶斯优化中采集函数最大化计算成本高，影响收敛和效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出在低维子空间离散集上优化采集函数，无需低维结构假设。
summary_zh.result: 算法保持收敛，累积遗憾亚线性增长，且可权衡收敛速率与子空间数量。

summary_en.motivation: Scaling Bayesian optimization to high dimensions is challenging due to the computational cost of maximizing the acquisition function, which degrades convergence and efficiency.
summary_en.method: A novel approach that maximizes the acquisition function only on a discrete set of low-dimensional subspaces embedded in the original high-dimensional space, without assuming low-dimensional structure.
summary_en.result: The algorithm achieves sublinear cumulative regret and provides a trade-off between convergence rate and the number of subspaces, reducing the regret bound by a factor of √D.
summary_en.validation: Extensive empirical experiments on optimization problems with dimensions up to 5000 demonstrate superior sample efficiency compared to existing methods.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决受外部因素影响的目标函数优化问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种考虑外部因素的贝叶斯优化框架。
summary_zh.result: 在数值基准上验证了方法的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize an objective function that is influenced by an external factor, which is common in real-world applications.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Bayesian optimization framework that incorporates the external factor as an additional input to the surrogate model.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates improved optimization performance on numerical benchmarks compared to standard BO ignoring the factor.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic numerical benchmark functions.

title: Bayesian Active Learning for Inverse Problem of Structured-Output

why_not_core: The paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification in the context of expensive simulation sampling.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解结构化输出逆问题，减少昂贵仿真调用次数。
summary_zh.method: 采用贝叶斯主动学习框架，通过不确定性引导采样。
summary_zh.result: 在数值基准上验证了采样效率和求解精度。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve inverse problems with structured outputs by minimizing expensive simulation calls.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian active learning framework that guides sampling based on uncertainty estimates.
summary_en.result: Demonstrated improved sampling efficiency and solution accuracy on numerical benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical benchmark problems.

title: A mechanical property evaluation of Ti6Al4V cellular lattice structures fabricated by selective laser melting
venue: IOP Conference Series Materials Science and Engineering
first_author_affiliation: Faculty of Engineering Technology, DRB Hicom University of Automotive Malaysia, 26600 Pekan, Pahang, Malaysia

corresponding_authors.name: Mohd Zaidi Azir
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Faculty of Engineering Technology, DRB Hicom University of Automotive Malaysia, 26600 Pekan, Pahang, Malaysia

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了Ti6Al4V点阵结构的力学性能，与用户关注的AM生物医学植入物方向相关，但缺乏疲劳测试和表面形貌分析。
why_not_core: This paper does not cover fatigue testing, surface roughness, as-built morphology, or osseointegration, and does not explicitly link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching for biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制备的Ti6Al4V点阵结构的力学性能，探索结构参数对弹性模量和抗压强度的影响。
summary_zh.method: 设计不同支柱尺寸、形状、单元尺寸和孔隙率的点阵结构，通过压缩试验测试力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 点阵结构的弹性模量在0.01-1.84 GPa之间，孔隙率对弹性模量和抗压强度影响显著。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩试验进行力学性能表征，对比不同设计参数下的结果。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the mechanical properties of Ti6Al4V cellular lattice structures fabricated by selective laser melting, aiming to understand the influence of design parameters on Young's modulus and compressive strength.
summary_en.method: Lattice structures with varying strut size, strut shape, unit cell size, and porosity were designed and fabricated via SLM, followed by compression testing.
summary_en.result: The Young's modulus of the fabricated structures ranged from 0.01 to 1.84 GPa, with porosity playing a dominant role in determining both modulus and compressive strength.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through compression tests, and the effects of design parameters were compared graphically.

why_not_core: This paper does not include any mechanical testing (static or fatigue) to evaluate stress shielding or stiffness matching, nor does it report as-built surface roughness or morphology.

summary_zh.motivation: 钛支架骨整合慢，需加速。
summary_zh.method: 3D打印多孔钛支架阳极氧化制备TiO2纳米管并负载VD3。
summary_zh.result: 体内外显示骨整合增强。
summary_zh.validation: 体内动物实验和体外细胞实验。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate osseointegration of titanium scaffolds by mimicking trabecular bone structure and local drug delivery.
summary_en.method: Hierarchical porous titanium scaffolds were fabricated via selective laser melting, anodized to form TiO2 nanotubes, and loaded with 1α,25-Dihydroxyvitamin D3.
summary_en.result: The drug-loaded hierarchical scaffolds significantly enhanced osteogenesis and early osseointegration in vitro and in vivo.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays and in vivo rat animal model.

title: High Cycle Fatigue Performance of LPBF 304L Stainless Steel at Nominal and Optimized Parameters
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Missouri University of Science and Technology, Rolla, MO 65401, USA

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Missouri University of Science and Technology, Rolla, MO 65401, USA

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了LPBF 304L不锈钢的高周疲劳性能，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或生物医学植入物背景。
why_not_core: No porous structure, no stress shielding or stiffness matching, no biomedical context, no surface roughness or osseointegration data.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究LPBF工艺参数对304L不锈钢高周疲劳性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过名义参数和优化参数制备试样，进行位移控制弯曲疲劳测试。
summary_zh.result: 水平方向优化参数试样疲劳强度最高，垂直方向名义参数试样最低。
summary_zh.validation: 通过控制信号监测方法分析疲劳测试结果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of LPBF process parameters on the high cycle fatigue performance of 304L stainless steel.
summary_en.method: Specimens were fabricated with nominal and optimized parameters, and displacement-controlled fully reversed bending fatigue tests were conducted.
summary_en.result: Horizontally built specimens with optimized parameters exhibited the highest fatigue strength, while vertically built specimens with nominal parameters showed the lowest.
summary_en.validation: Fatigue test results were analyzed using the control signal monitoring method.

title: A Blackbox Yield Estimation Workflow with Gaussian Process Regression for Industrial Problems.
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合高斯过程回归与蒙特卡洛采样的黑箱良率估计方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的不确定性量化问题。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on yield estimation in industrial contexts without applying the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决不确定性量化中计算成本高的问题
summary_zh.method: 混合方法：大部分样本用高斯过程代理模型评估，少数用高保真模型重评估
summary_zh.result: 实现了高效且可靠的随机良率估计
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the computational feasibility challenge in uncertainty quantification for stochastic yield estimation.
summary_en.method: A hybrid approach combining Gaussian Process Regression surrogate with selective high-fidelity reevaluation of Monte Carlo samples.
summary_en.result: The workflow achieves efficient and reliable yield estimation with reduced computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark problems typical of industrial applications.

title: A Blackbox Yield Estimation Workflow with Gaussian Process Regression Applied to the Design of Electromagnetic Devices
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于高斯过程回归的混合蒙特卡洛方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的良率估计，但缺乏对约束处理和生物力学应用的直接验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not address multi-objective optimization with constraints, nor does it apply to implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on electromagnetic devices without any biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决电磁设备良率估计中蒙特卡洛采样计算成本高的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出混合方法，用高斯过程代理模型评估大部分样本，仅少量样本用高保真模型重评估
summary_zh.result: 在介质波导和低通滤波器基准问题上优于经典方法
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个电磁基准问题的数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of Monte Carlo sampling for yield estimation in electromagnetic device design.
summary_en.method: A hybrid approach using Gaussian Process Regression as a surrogate to evaluate most samples, with only a few reevaluated by the high-fidelity model based on an error indicator.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms classical approaches on two benchmark problems: a dielectric waveguide and a lowpass filter.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via numerical benchmarks on electromagnetic devices.

title: Variational Inference with Vine Copulas: An efficient Approach for Bayesian Computer Model Calibration
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于变分贝叶斯推断和藤蔓copula的高效贝叶斯计算机模型校准方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的校准与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization; it focuses on Bayesian calibration of general computer models with Gaussian processes.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决昂贵计算机模型校准中的计算效率问题
summary_zh.method: 采用变分贝叶斯推断结合藤蔓copula分解数据似然
summary_zh.result: 在核物理液滴模型校准中展示了计算可扩展性
summary_zh.validation: 通过理论分析和数值基准测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the computational inefficiency of Bayesian calibration for expensive computer models with dependent data.
summary_en.method: A variational Bayes inference algorithm is combined with vine copulas to decompose the data likelihood, preserving scalability.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates computational scalability and is applied to calibrate the Liquid Drop Model of nuclear binding energies.
summary_en.validation: Validation includes theoretical analysis and numerical benchmarks on a real-world nuclear physics example.

title: Model order reduction of thermo-mechanical models with parametric convective boundary conditions: focus on machine tool
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的参数化模型降阶方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no uncertainty quantification, and no experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低机床热-机械耦合有限元模型的计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 提出Krylov模态子空间降阶方法，通过双线性化处理参数化对流边界条件。
summary_zh.result: 降阶模型在关注频段内准确复现原系统响应。
summary_zh.validation: 数值算例验证降阶模型精度。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of weakly coupled thermo-mechanical finite element models for machine tools.
summary_en.method: A Krylov Modal Subspace (KMS) reduction method is proposed, handling parametric convective boundary conditions via system bilinearization.
summary_en.result: The reduced-order model accurately captures the original system response in the frequency range of interest.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through a numerical example comparing the reduced and full-order models.

title: Incorporating Expert Prior in Bayesian Optimisation via Space Warping
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种通过空间扭曲将专家先验融入贝叶斯优化的方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: No validation on FEA or biomechanical design problems; no uncertainty quantification beyond GP posterior; no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少贝叶斯优化在昂贵黑箱函数优化中的冷启动阶段。
summary_zh.method: 通过先验分布扭曲搜索空间，重新定义高斯过程核矩阵以融入先验。
summary_zh.result: 在基准函数和超参数调优中优于标准贝叶斯优化。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个基准函数和SVM、随机森林超参数调优上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To mitigate the cold-start phase in Bayesian optimization of expensive black-box functions by leveraging expert prior knowledge.
summary_en.method: A space warping approach that uses a prior distribution over the optimum to expand high-probability regions and shrink low-probability regions, incorporated into the GP kernel.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms standard Bayesian optimization on benchmark functions and hyperparameter tuning of SVM and Random Forest.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic benchmark functions and two machine learning hyperparameter tuning tasks.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发3D打印多孔钛合金棒治疗早期股骨头坏死。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a 3D-printed porous titanium alloy rod for treating early-stage femoral head osteonecrosis.
summary_en.method: A biomimetic lamellar porous structure was designed and fabricated via LPBF, then implanted in sheep.
summary_en.result: Good bone ingrowth was observed at 12 weeks post-implantation, but mechanical properties were not evaluated.
summary_en.validation: In vivo sheep model with histological analysis.

title: Interval Neural Networks: Uncertainty Scores
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的区间神经网络方法可用于代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及有限元仿真或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate application, no implant or biomechanics context, and no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 快速获取深度神经网络输出的不确定性分数。
summary_zh.method: 提出区间神经网络，使用区间参数和区间算术传播不确定性。
summary_zh.result: 区间神经网络能产生包含真实值的上下界，且非对称不确定性提供额外方向信息。
summary_zh.validation: 在图像重建任务上对比两种不确定性量化方法。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a fast, non-Bayesian method for producing uncertainty scores in deep neural network outputs.
summary_en.method: Proposes an interval neural network (INN) with interval-valued parameters that propagates inputs using interval arithmetic.
summary_en.result: The INN produces sensible lower and upper bounds encompassing ground truth, with asymmetric uncertainty scores offering directional information.
summary_en.validation: Validated on an image reconstruction task and compared against two state-of-the-art uncertainty quantification methods.

title: In Vitro Bioactivity and Biocompatibility of Bio-Inspired Ti-6Al-4V Alloy Surfaces Modified by Combined Laser Micro/Nano Structuring

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了激光微纳结构对钛合金表面生物活性和生物相容性的影响，但与应力遮挡、疲劳性能或LPBF制造无直接关联。
why_not_core: This paper does not cover LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), stress shielding, or porous structure design; it focuses on laser surface texturing and in vitro bioactivity.

summary_zh.motivation: 改善钛合金植入体的骨整合性能
summary_zh.method: 采用微秒激光和飞秒激光制备复合微纳结构表面

summary_en.motivation: To improve osseointegration of titanium alloy implants by mimicking bio-inspired surface topographies.
summary_en.method: Composite micro/nano-structures (micro-hexagons and nano-ripples) were fabricated on Ti-6Al-4V using microsecond and femtosecond laser processing.
summary_en.result: The bioinspired micro/nano-structured surfaces exhibited superior bioactivity in SBF and enhanced MC3T3 osteoblast proliferation and alignment.
summary_en.validation: In vitro bioactivity (simulated body fluid) and biocompatibility (osteoblastic cell culture) assays were performed.
