relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了贝叶斯优化在复杂物理系统调优中的高效性，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理模型优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanical implant design; it focuses on free-electron laser tuning.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少自由电子激光器频繁配置的调优时间。
summary_zh.method: 使用高斯过程代理模型进行贝叶斯优化，平衡探索与利用。
summary_zh.result: 显著优于现有优化器，样本效率高。
summary_zh.validation: 在LCLS自由电子激光器上实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the tuning time for frequent reconfigurations of a free-electron laser.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian optimization framework using Gaussian process surrogate models to balance exploration and exploitation.
summary_en.result: The proposed method significantly outperforms existing optimizers in sample efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation on the Linac Coherent Light Source free-electron laser.

title: Robust Parameter Inversion using Adaptive Reduced Order Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合自适应降阶模型和随机估计的鲁棒参数反演方法，可显著降低大规模PDE求解的计算成本，其思想可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真替代建模。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on inverse problems in diffuse optical tomography, not on forward surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics or stress shielding prediction.

summary_zh.motivation: 非线性参数反演问题计算成本高，传统降阶模型缺乏误差界。
summary_zh.method: 提出自适应降阶模型结合随机估计，每次优化只需一次随机全阶求解。
summary_zh.result: 新方法在保证鲁棒性的同时，将大规模线性求解次数减少46%-98%。
summary_zh.validation: 在漫射光学层析成像数值算例中验证了效率和鲁棒性。

summary_en.motivation: Nonlinear parametric inverse problems are computationally expensive, and standard reduced-order models lack rigorous error bounds in high-dimensional parameter spaces.
summary_en.method: An adaptive reduced-order model with stochastic estimates is proposed, requiring only one randomized full-scale linear solve per optimization step.
summary_en.result: The method reduces the number of large linear solves by 46%-98% compared to fixed reduced-order models while maintaining robustness.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on diffuse optical tomography demonstrate the efficiency and robustness of the proposed inversion method.

title: Osseointegration potential of mesenchymal stem cells on porous heat treated and untreated 3D-printed Ti6Al4V scaffolds
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了多孔Ti6Al4V支架的骨整合潜力，涉及LPBF制造和热处理，但未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳测试。
why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, stiffness matching, or fatigue behavior; it focuses on in vitro cell response rather than mechanical performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过多孔支架和干细胞提高骨整合以防止植入物松动。
summary_zh.method: LPBF制造Ti6Al4V多孔支架，热处理后接种间充质干细胞进行体外实验。
summary_zh.result: 热处理与未处理支架上的细胞粘附、增殖和分化差异不大。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验验证骨整合潜力。

summary_en.motivation: To improve implant fixation by combining porous Ti6Al4V scaffolds with mesenchymal stem cells for enhanced osseointegration.
summary_en.method: Porous Ti6Al4V scaffolds were fabricated by laser powder bed fusion, heat-treated at 600°C for 20 hours, and seeded with rat and human MSCs for in vitro cell assays.
summary_en.result: Heat-treated and untreated scaffolds showed marginal differences in MSC adhesion, proliferation, and differentiation.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture experiments with MSCs on scaffolds.

title: Data-driven surrogates for high dimensional models using Gaussian process regression on the Grassmann manifold

why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context; no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification beyond standard GP; validation only on ODE and plasticity model, not on FEA or biomedical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维随机系统仿真成本高，需高效代理模型
summary_zh.method: 利用Grassmann流形降维，结合聚类和GPR在切空间建立代理

summary_en.motivation: Standard Bayesian optimization assumes equal evaluation costs, but in practice costs may vary across the search space.

summary_en.result: On 20 black-box function optimization problems, CArBO finds significantly better hyperparameter configurations than competing methods under the same cost budget.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark functions for black-box optimization.

title: Uncertainty quantification of reduced models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的不确定性量化方法可用于生物力学代理模型的验证与降阶模型评估，但未涉及植入物设计或有限元分析。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on reduced models for combustion and soot oxidation, with no application to biomedical FEA, implant mechanics, or surrogate modeling for structural design.

summary_zh.motivation: 燃烧模拟中详细模型计算昂贵，需要降阶模型并量化其不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 采用Bound-to-Bound Data Collaboration框架和Gibbs采样进行不确定性量化。

summary_en.motivation: Detailed reaction models in combustion are computationally expensive, necessitating reduced models with rigorous uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: Uncertainty propagation is quantified using the Bound-to-Bound Data Collaboration framework and Gibbs sampling, with sampling- and optimization-based measures.
summary_en.result: The developed measures successfully quantify uncertainty propagation and differentiate the performance of various reduced models, showing that ignoring parameter uncertainty can be misleading.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on three numerical examples involving syngas combustion and soot oxidation reduced models.

summary_zh.method: 提出半侵入式方法，将单尺度组件视为黑箱，结合灵敏度分析降维。
summary_zh.result: 在支架内再狭窄模型中验证了效率提升。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多尺度生物医学仿真案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Uncertainty quantification for multiscale models is computationally expensive, motivating efficient dimensionality reduction.
summary_en.method: A semi-intrusive approach treats single-scale components as black-boxes and applies sensitivity analysis to reduce input dimensionality.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates improved efficiency on a multiscale model of in-stent restenosis.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through a simulation case study of a biomedical multiscale model.

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency and accuracy of reliability analysis for implicit and nonlinear performance functions.
summary_en.method: A collaborative active learning strategy is designed to augment the radial basis function metamodel (CAL-ARBF) by constraining new samples to be in sensitivity regions, near the limit state surface, and mutually distant.

summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on four numerical examples: global nonlinear, local nonlinear, nonlinear oscillator, and truss structure problems.
